exposure: early-term births (37-38 weeks of gestational age)
Early-term birth (37-38 weeks of gestational age)
cohort: 1678 full-term infants and 727 early-term infants born at a single tertiary hospital between October 2013 and February 2017
finding: Early-term birth was associated with a 43% increased odds of neurodevelopmental delay in the PDI domain, but not the MDI domain, at age 2 years.
mod_finding: The association between early-term birth and delayed neurodevelopment was more prominent among infants born by cesarean section.
